name: FairFlow
tagline: Community lending where spending transparency, explained by AI, replaces credit scores.

awards: Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban

problem: Neighbours are price-gouged by short-term credit even when their spending shows they are trustworthy.
solution: Borrowers link transaction data; an AI explains a clarity score; lenders in the community fund loans with a shared feed.
demo_moment: Team-described: request a loan and see a neighbour fund it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Vibe Kanban by Vibe Kanban” among 195 submissions.

lessons: Social proof can stand in for credit history in a pitch.
